decision.observation: The car remains immobilized at 0 mph in first gear between two trees; repeated forward and reverse inputs have not freed it, and all six indicators are blue.
decision.hypothesis: Pressing Escape again may advance the recovery or reset state, as it previously changed the indicators and camera while the car was stuck.
decision.memory: Straight throttle after engaging first gear did not move the car. Further steering risks wedging it more tightly; use the established recovery input and reassess.
